gcm.purpose: Backfill Sept. 8 Search Console reports into Signal Review without restoring Gmail polling.
changeNotes: Adds a one-time D1 backfill for A1, Pickett Weaponry, South Florida Safes, and HB Guns August Search Console reports received Sept. 8.
Backfilled records enter Today as ready_for_review and create no downstream operational records until human review.
Signal Review now infers August 2026 from month-only report subjects using the source email year.
